User-agent: *
# Disallow access to sitemap index
Disallow: /sitemap_index.xml

# Disallow tracking parameters
Disallow: /*utm_source=
Disallow: /*utm_medium=
Disallow: /*utm_campaign=
Disallow: /*utm_term=
Disallow: /*utm_content=
Disallow: /*utm_id=
Disallow: /*sfmc_activityid=
Disallow: /*sfmc_journey_id=
Disallow: /*sfmc_journey_name=
Disallow: /*dealercode=
Disallow: /*ltclid=

# Disallow malformed URLs with repeated ampersands
Disallow: /*&&
Disallow: /*&body=

# Disallow unnecessary query parameters
Disallow: /*?wc-ajax=
Disallow: /*?post_type=
Disallow: /*?s=

# Disallow unnecessary fragments and paths
Disallow: /*menu-bwvsd
Disallow: /*tp_sp

# Allow access to necessary parts of the site
Allow: /$
Allow: /blog/
Allow: /press/
Allow: /projects/

# Disallow duplicate content caused by tracking fragments
Disallow: /*&trk=
Disallow: /*?trk=

# Sitemap
Sitemap: https://darglobal.co.uk/sitemap.xml
